text: Design advanced precision equipment for accurate or controlled applications.
Budget and schedule security design work.
Maintain medical records, technical library, or correspondence files.

Plan, direct, or coordinate the activities of workers in branches, offices, or departments of establishments, such as branch banks, brokerage firms, risk and insurance departments, or credit departments.
Provide system design and integration recommendations.
Determine the sequence of machine operations, and select the proper cutting tools needed to machine workpieces into the desired shapes.
Learn material and pass required tests for certification.
Examine systems to locate problems, such as loose connections or broken insulation.
Implement electronic document processing, retrieval, and distribution systems in collaboration with other information technology specialists.
Analyze soil to determine types or quantities of fertilizer required for maximum crop production.
Assign schedules to work crews.
Analyze technology trends to identify markets for future product development or to improve sales of existing products.
Assist customers, such as responding to customer complaints and updating them about back-ordered parts.
Manage the logistical aspects of product life cycles, including coordination or provisioning of samples, and the minimization of obsolescence.
Service motors by performing tasks such as changing oil and lubricating parts.
Participate in the recruitment of employees through job fairs, career days, or advertising plans.
Monitor functioning of equipment and make necessary modifications to ensure system operates in conformance with specifications.
Disassemble and store equipment after performances.
Lead, or participate in, fraud investigation teams.
Transport guests about premises and local areas, or arrange for transportation.
Monitor water use, demand, or quality in a particular geographic area.
Interview job applicants to obtain and verify information used to screen and evaluate them.
Allocate and manage laboratory space and resources.
Develop testing procedures.
Conduct office automation feasibility studies, including workflow analysis, space design, or cost comparison analysis.
Diagnose and resolve media system problems.
Conduct interviews for broadcasts.
Check original texts or confer with authors to ensure that translations retain the content, meaning, and feeling of the original material.
Arrange insurance coverage for goods.
Report incidences of child or elder abuse, neglect, or threats of harm to authorities, as required.
Meet with clients to negotiate management and service contracts, determine priorities, and discuss the financial and operational status of properties.
Record production and operational data on specified forms.
Ensure that lab cleanliness and safety standards are maintained.
Rebuild gas or diesel engines.
Provide advice and consultation on economic relationships to businesses, public and private agencies, and other employers.
Compile data pertinent to manufacture of special products for customers.
Review, recommend, or approve contracts or cost estimates.
Apply coatings or operate systems to mitigate corrosion of geothermal plant equipment or structures.
Sort and file correspondence and perform miscellaneous clerical duties, such as answering correspondence and writing reports.
Attend sales or trade meetings or read related publications to obtain information about market conditions, business trends, environmental regulations, or industry developments.
Key in processing instructions to program electronic equipment.
Conduct evaluations of employees' performance.
Inspect, clean, and repair drainage systems, bridges, tunnels, and other structures.
Establish and enforce operating procedures and work standards that will ensure adequate performance and personnel safety.
Assist in budget implementation, forecasts, or administration.
Resolve worker problems or collaborate with employees to assist in problem resolution.
Observe and evaluate workers' appearance and performance to ensure quality service and compliance with specifications.
Provide, or refer patients to other providers for, education or counseling on topics such as genetic testing, newborn care, contraception, or breastfeeding.
